ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. Students will need a web cam, working external microphone/speakers or headset with microphone, reliable high-speed Internet and access to scanner capable of producing .pdf files. This section has one or more proctored exams which may carry additional fees. Proctor U capability required. For technical specifications and additional information found at: http://www.ao.uiuc.edu/support/source/student_services/proctoru_tech.html. Last scheduled class meeting will be December 5. Final exam is on December 12.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS: FSHN (Online) -UIUC, MS:FSci &Hmn Nutrition -UIUC, or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $362.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
